correctness.rationale: The actual verify.py embeds 100 tetrahedra, constructs 117 edges and 200 2-faces, contracts a spanning tree to 101 cycle coordinates and uses unimodular operations to exhibit 1^99,3,0 Smith factors. Its integral/free and mod-3 cocycles annihilate every facial relation and hit g and t independently, identifying H1=Z+Z/3. An independent implementation parsing only tetrahedra and cocycle coefficient tables (without executing verifier) found 439 graph triangles, 239 nonfaces, zero facial cocycle violations, witness coordinates (1,0),(0,1), and exact signed multiplicities 70,60,20,21,16,18,23,11. No zero among these 239. Since a simple cycle has >=3 edges the systole is 3; all free coordinates are ±1.

value.rationale: This is a complete intrinsic shortest-cycle homology census on a canonical vertex-minimal triangulation of a natural flat 3-manifold, identifying torsion and primitive free systoles in an explicit splitting; the precision can be used in discrete topology and triangulation comparisons.
residual_risks: Only this fixed labelled triangulation is classified; an unindexed historical triangulation census might have the same 239 counts. Smith reduction source was inspected for valid unimodular steps; independent implementation reproduced cocycles/counts, not every Smith pivot.

final_claim: In the fixed 17-vertex Lutz G3 triangulation, all 239 nonfacial graph triangles are nonzero H1 classes and split unoriented as 130 pure order-3 torsion, 41 primitive free, 34 and 34 free-plus-torsion carriers.
limitations: Only this fixed labelled triangulation is classified; an unindexed historical triangulation census might have the same 239 counts. Smith reduction source was inspected for valid unimodular steps; independent implementation reproduced cocycles/counts, not every Smith pivot.
